metadata.name: CardToBankAccountTransfer
metadata.description: Use this API to transfer funds from card account to external bank Account only when the status of bank account and card is active. A valid card number and transaction amount should be provided as input for a successful transfer.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: DecisionFlag
request_fields.description: Used for performing various operations when respective flag values defined below are passed. 1 = To Get Recipient ID, Recipient Name and Nick Name etc. 2 = Fund Transfer from Card to Bank. 3 = Adding a new Recipient Bank Account. 4 = Fund Transfer from Card to Bank by given Recipient Bank Account information. 5 = Delete Recipient Bank Account information. 6 = Get Recipient Bank Account information. 7 = Update Recipient Bank Account information. 8 = Set Recipient Bank Account Active/Inactive. Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: TransferType
request_fields.description: Type of  money transfer. Valid values: 0 = Card To Bank 1 = Bank To Card Example: 0 Condition :0 (Card To Bank) is applicable for  decision flags 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 and 8. 1 (Bank To Card) is applicable for  decision flags 1,3,5 and 7 only. Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: FromCardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder from where a transaction is initiated. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition : At least one of  From Card Number/ From Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: FromProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder from where a transaction is initiated Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition : At least one of  From Card Number/ From Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: RecipientId
request_fields.description: UniqueID of Recipient. Valid Values:0-9 Example:1234567890 Condition: It is Mandatory when DecisionFlag = 2,5,6,7 and 8

request_fields.name: RecipientName
request_fields.description: First Name of Recipient. Valid Values:- A-Z,a-z , special characters ( '- .,) and Ampersand Example: Andrick Condition: It is mandatory for below scenario: DecisionFlag = 3 and TransferType = 1 or 0, DecisionFlag = 4 and TransferType = 0 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AccountNickName
request_fields.description: Nick name of the account Valid Values:- A-Z,a-z , special characters ( '- .,) and Ampersand Example: Sem Condition: It is mandatory when DecisionFlag = 3 and 4. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: TranactionAmount
request_fields.description: Transaction Amount Valid Values: 0-9 Example:100.11 Condition:It is Mandatory when DecisionFlag = 2 and 4.

request_fields.name: AccountType
request_fields.description: Type of account. Valid Values: 0 = Checking 1 = Savings Example:0 Condition: It is Mandatory when DecisionFlag =3 and 4. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: ConfirmBankAccountNumber
request_fields.description: Re-enter Cardholder's Bank Account Number for confirmation Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1122345678 Condition: It is Mandatory when DecisionFlag =3,4 and 7 Allowable Values: 17

request_fields.name: BankAccountNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder's Bank Account Number Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1122345678 Condition: It is Mandatory when DecisionFlag =3,4 and 7 Allowable Values: 17

request_fields.name: RoutingNumber
request_fields.description: Bank Routing Number Valid Values:0-9 Example:0110000015 Condition: It is Mandatory when DecisionFlag = 3,4 and 7 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: ReasonDescription
request_fields.description: Flag for PreDefined Memo Reasons. Please refer appendix Section : Memo Reason Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: Note
request_fields.description: Notes entered by the user Valid Values : A-Z,0-9 Example : Card found Allowable Values: 396

request_fields.name: BankStatus
request_fields.description: Status of  Bank Account. Valid Values  :1 = Active 0 = Inactive Example : 1 Condition: It is mandatory for Decision Flag = 8. Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: ExternalBankStatus
request_fields.description: External Bank Account Status. Valid Values: 0-7 Example:1 (Validated) Appendix Section:ExternalBankStatus Condition: It is Mandatory when DecisionFlag = 7 or 3 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: SameDayACHType
request_fields.description: For sending transaction in Same Day ACH file, use this field. Valid values: SD1300 or SD1700 Example: SD1300 Allowable Values: 6

request_fields.name: FromWalletID
request_fields.description: Wallet ID of wallet mapped on account Valid values: 0-9 Example: 1005 Condition: Mandatory when card product structure is multi wallet. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: TransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Transaction Amount Valid Values: 0-9 Example:100.11 Condition:It is Mandatory when DecisionFlag = 2 and 4.

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: TransactionId
children.description: Transaction ID of Debit Transaction on Source Card.

children.name: BankAccountNumber
children.description: Cardholder's Bank Account Number Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1122345678 Allowable Values: 11

children.name: AccountType
children.description: Type of account. Valid Values: 0 =Checking 1 =Savings Example:0 Allowable Values: 3

children.name: RoutingNumber
children.description: Bank Routing Number Valid Values:0-9 Example:0110000015 Allowable Values: 9

children.name: FinancialInstituteName
children.description: Name of Financial Institution Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example:FEDERAL RESERVE BANK Allowable Values: 200

children.name: RecipientName
children.description: First Name of Recipient. Valid Values:A-Z,a-z. Example: Andrick Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RecipientId
children.description: UniqueID of Recipient. Valid Values:0-9 Example:1234567890

children.name: AccountNickName
children.description: Nick name of the account Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example: Sem Allowable Values: 0

children.name: RecipientName
children.description: First Name of Recipient. Valid Values:A-Z,a-z. Example: Andrick Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AddedBankStatus
children.description: Status of Bank Account. Valid values: 1 = Active 0 = Inactive Allowable Values: 5

children.name: TransferType
children.description: Type of  money transfer. Valid values: 0 = Card To Bank 1 = Bank To Card Example: 0 Allowable Values: 5
